data.display_address: Rahaal 2, Madinat Jumeirah Living, Umm Suqeim, Dubai
data.long_description:
Presenting an exceptional 4-bedroom plus maid’s apartment in Madinat Jumeirah Living Rahaal 2, one of Dubai’s most sought-after freehold communities offering a refined lifestyle in the heart of Umm Suqeim. Spanning 2,784.52 sqft, this elegant residence combines contemporary architecture with spacious interiors and stunning views of the iconic Burj Al Arab.

Designed with comfort and sophistication in mind, the apartment features a bright open-plan living and dining area complemented by large floor-to-ceiling windows that allow abundant natural light throughout the home. The modern kitchen comes fully fitted with premium cabinetry and high-quality finishes, while all bedrooms are generously sized with built-in wardrobes and luxurious en-suite bathrooms. The maid’s room provides additional convenience and functionality for family living.

Residents of Rahaal 2 enjoy a serene pedestrian-friendly environment inspired by traditional Arabian architecture while being surrounded by lush landscaped pathways and premium lifestyle amenities. This exclusive development offers direct connectivity to Dubai’s major attractions while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere ideal for families and investors alike.
